historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly recognizes irreversible SEL erasure but uses an unsafe non-IPMI SSH substitute and lacks target, export, completion and post-state controls.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires a single explicitly approved erase, protected BMC path, complete retained export and no ambiguous retry or unrelated log clearing.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A successful command acknowledgement is not sufficient: the operation must prove the exact repository was selected, that its pre-erase contents are immutably retained, that erasure completed rather than remained in progress, and that an empty listing is not a transport or permission failure.

original_test_intent: Erase the selected BMC SEL repository and verify that all event records in that repository are empty after completion.
original_method: On an isolated owner-approved target, capture and hash the complete SEL repository and metadata, issue one protected supported clear operation, observe bounded completion/status semantics, then re-read SEL info and entries to prove the intended repository is empty while retaining the irreversible audit evidence.
manual_activity: The owner approves the isolated repository, irreversible erase, retention and recovery/escalation policy; an operator independently verifies the complete export and owns the final verdict.
required_inputs: Dedicated maintenance window and owner approval
Complete SEL export and immutable hash location
Supported ipmitool or vendor clear/status semantics
safety_requirements: Never clear SEL as routine setup
Never operate on production, shared or incident-bearing repositories
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or other repositories
Stop on ambiguous completion or unexpected state
Never automatically retry an uncertain erase
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, approval and export integrity
Capture SEL info and all records
Verify repository identity and empty post-state

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SSH `sel clear` substitute is unsafe, exposes a password, disables host-key checking and neither binds the exact BMC repository nor validates full export and clear completion.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval and verified immutable export, issue one protected `ipmitool sel clear` or vendor reserve/clear/status flow, then prove bounded completion and empty repository via full SEL metadata and entry reads.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 5/5-minute estimate and selected SEL erase intent remain; `all logs` is bounded to the SEL event records stated by the test, not unrelated system logs.

modernized_recommendation.status: SINGLE-SHOT APPROVAL-GATED SEL ERASE WITH IMMUTABLE EXPORT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a transaction ledger containing repository identity, pre-export hash/count, approval, reservation, clear response, status timeline, post-info/count and audit retention path.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds irreversible evidence retention, exact target binding, status verification and an explicit prohibition on generic setup clearing or retry.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A `sel clear` acknowledgement and empty filtered list cannot distinguish successful erase from wrong target, in-progress deletion, access failure or lost evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Deleted SEL records have no guaranteed command-level restore; the retained export is forensic evidence, not repository restoration.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define the supported clear/status path, repository ownership, retention and escalation. Any request to erase other logs is outside this SEL case and needs its own explicit destructive contract.
expected_evidence: Complete pre-erase SEL info/records with immutable hash
Supported clear request, response and reservation/status timeline
Post-erase SEL info and empty entry proof
No-unintended-repository audit, retained export and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and the During Test steps consistently identify SEL clear and event-log emptiness. The broad word `all` in Criteria is interpreted by its immediate SEL context; generic setup log clearing is unsafe boilerplate, not a competing required target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is executable when an isolated target, explicit approval, complete export and supported clear/status package exist. It blocks at execution if any irreversible-control prerequisite is unavailable or evidence is incident-bearing.

review_improvement: Turns a one-line irreversible clear into a target-bound, evidence-preserving, single-shot transaction with completion proof and no unsafe retry.
independent_technical_reasoning: SEL erase can be asynchronous and repository implementations may expose erase-in-progress or stale metadata. An empty list can also result from channel failure or insufficient privilege. Comparing pre/post repository identity, allocation metadata and entry reads after bounded completion is necessary to prove the intended destructive state transition.
